div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: Node (python -m donutcoin.node) - the chain, the rules

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: Miner (python -m donutcoin.miner) - on Donut, or anyone's laptop

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
no: nonce += 1
every 500 hashes: count, check stop flag

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: any rule fails -> 400, one hash wasted

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
GET /api/template?address=D...
prev hash, height, bits (target), timestamp,
waiting txs, a coinbase paying 10,000 DONUT + fees to the address

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
One worker process per thread.
Each sets its own coinbase tag (tag/thread/pid) ->
its own coinbase txid -> its own merkle root -> its own 80-byte header

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Loop: header[0:76] + nonce (4 bytes)
h = scrypt(header, N=1024 r=1 p=1)
int(h) <= target ?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Found: block = header + txs -> POST /api/block
(X-Donut-Key if this miner belongs to the node's operator; not required)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Every second: GET /api/info.
Tip moved or mempool changed -> stop workers, fetch a new template

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Validate, in order:
1 extends the tip? 2 bits == next_bits()? (retarget every 10 blocks, 4x clamp)
3 scrypt(header) <= target? 4 timestamp > median of last 11, < now+2h?
5 at a checkpoint height, the pinned block id?
6 first tx is the coinbase for this height, one output?
7 no duplicate txids 8 each tx: inputs unspent, mature, signed by the owner, out <= in
9 coinbase <= 10,000 DONUT + fees

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Apply: spend inputs, add outputs to the UTXO set,
drop included txs from the mempool, append to chain.jsonl
